data.description:
## Context / Problem

Private aliases remain across plan-review orchestrator sizing/context/move registries, runner Anthropic/tool/structured-run names, workflow gate-dispatch recovery names, and `llm.config` gate-context names. `llm.usage_log.failure_usage` also misnames the neutral `run_shape` record and has live callers.

The governing ADR is earthen-wheat-chick [rebar:earthen-wheat-chick]. The configuration-reader extraction is unstable-vitriolic-conch [rebar:unstable-vitriolic-conch].

## Approach

After both prerequisites, migrate every consumer to `plan_review.sizing`, `context_assembly`, `passes`, `anthropic_model`, `runner_support`, `structured_run`, `workflow.plan_review_recovery`, and `llm.gate_context`. Rename `failure_usage` completely to `run_shape` and prove emitted dictionaries and durable JSONL rows are byte/field identical. Remove each old private binding only after semantic and raw dynamic/monkeypatch census is empty.

## Scope

- plan-review, runner, workflow-dispatch, and gate-context private re-exports
- usage-log implementation, callers, docs, experiment prose, and JSONL tests
- all source/test/string/dynamic/monkeypatch consumers

## Testing

Run focused plan-review/workflow/runner suites; compare old/new usage record dictionaries and JSONL rows across success and failure paths; run semantic and raw reference scans.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every enumerated old LLM/workflow private binding has no repository consumer and its named canonical owner is the sole binding.
- [ ] `failure_usage` is absent and `run_shape` owns all former behavior.
- [ ] Success and failure records retain byte/field-identical dictionaries and durable JSONL rows after the rename.
- [ ] Gate-context, plan-review recovery, runner, and workflow behavior remain covered by focused tests.
- [ ] Static, string, dynamic-import, `getattr`, and monkeypatch census proves old paths absent.
data.title: Migrate and remove LLM, plan-review, and workflow internal shims
